name: Otose ~Toraware no Eien~
source:
Main character is a shy student who is ridiculed by girl students. However, he is attracted to a girl who once touched him gently. But his thoughts gradually become dangerous ...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名害羞的学生，经常遭女同学嘲笑。然而，他被曾经温柔触碰过自己的女孩吸引。可是，他的想法逐渐变得危险……

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
